problem_text:
A logistics coordinator is organizing shipments into identical cargo pods. The items to be shipped are:
* Component Alpha: mass 64 units
* Component Beta: mass 67 units
* Component Gamma: mass 68 units
* Component Delta: mass 58 units
* Component Epsilon: mass 50 units
* Component Zeta: mass 41 units
* Component Eta: mass 35 units
* Component Theta: mass 50 units
* Component Iota: mass 40 units
* Component Kappa: mass 47 units
* Component Lambda: mass 52 units
* Component Mu: mass 37 units
* Component Nu: mass 37 units
* Component Xi: mass 54 units
* Component Omicron: mass 50 units
* Component Pi: mass 50 units
* Component Rho: mass 49 units
* Component Sigma: mass 51 units
* Component Tau: mass 30 units
* Component Upsilon: mass 42 units
* Component Phi: mass 49 units
* Component Chi: mass 70 units
* Component Psi: mass 41 units
* Component Omega: mass 40 units
* Component Ares: mass 65 units
* Component Zeus: mass 40 units
* Component Hera: mass 60 units
* Component Poseidon: mass 45 units
* Component Athena: mass 35 units
* Component Apollo: mass 63 units

Each cargo pod has a maximum capacity of 100 mass units. Load all components using the minimum number of pods. Every component must be placed in exactly one pod, and the total mass in any pod cannot surpass its capacity limit.
